# hg launch

**What this page tells you:** every `hg launch` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The whole acceptance matrix for an environment, aggregated.

## Synopsis

```text
hg launch prove [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

LAUNCH001..006: aggregates the auth/grafana/backup/recovery subjects. A subject that cannot be run reads `unknown` — never a pass.

## `hg launch prove`

```text
hg launch prove [flags]
```

Run every subject's matrix and aggregate.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--browser` | — | — | Add the Nexus browser acceptance run (playwright against the exposed Nexus). |
